formats.label: One surprising fact, explained in a story
formats.structure: Open with a shocking claim, explain why it is true in 3 short beats, end with a one-line takeaway.

formats.label: Three quick facts on one theme
formats.structure: Promise three things in the hook, deliver each in one or two sentences, number them clearly.

formats.label: A common belief that is wrong
formats.structure: State what everyone believes, say it is wrong, give the real reason, end with what to do instead.

formats.label: A practical trick the viewer can use today
formats.structure: Promise the result, give the trick step by step, end with why it works.

formats.label: A funny, relatable observation, meme style
formats.structure: Describe a situation every Indian viewer has lived through, exaggerate it a little, build to one punchline, keep it warm and never insulting to a group.

formats.label: A tiny true story with a twist
formats.structure: Set the scene in one sentence, raise the stakes, land the twist in the last line. Real people and real events only.
